name: event-after-run-error-fatal
description: nothing follows RUN_ERROR except the RUN_STARTED of the next run: an ordinary event after a failed run is fatal, a second RUN_ERROR included, even though a run follows it on the same stream. Local to this repository: the upstream corpus has no stream for what may follow RUN_ERROR other than a new run
kill: admit after RUN_ERROR what is admitted after RUN_FINISHED, a late RUN_ERROR, or keep the failed run open for further events until the next RUN_STARTED

expect.errorContains: The run has already errored with 'RUN_ERROR'
